title: ResearchOS Hypothesis
description: A hypothesis. Records written before the 2026-10-21 hypothesis-cycle work (state/hypotheses.jsonl, state/hypotheses.d/2026-10-21-3990b64b4fdb.jsonl and the round-1 shard, listed in state/cycle_exemptions.json) predate the cycle fields; every record in a newer file must carry them. The fields exist so that a loop can run without controlled experiments: derived_from_evidence_ids records which observations GENERATED the hypothesis (those observations can never also count as its support), refutation_condition states before the fact what observation would kill it, and the next_* lists say what to look for next. The next_* list was SPLIT on 2026-10-21: round 1 found that every existing list held self-experiments or internal measurements and no literature question, so the search planner had nothing it could search for. See docs/2026-10-21_hypothesis-cycle-automation.md sections 3 (S4-S7), 5 and 13.

round.description: Loop round that produced this record. Required for every hypothesis in a file not listed in state/cycle_exemptions.json.

derived_from_evidence_ids.description: EVDs used to GENERATE the hypothesis. A relation from one of these observations is marked derived_from=true and is excluded from the support count (docs/2026-10-21_hypothesis-cycle-automation.md section 5).

refutation_condition.description: What observation would refute the hypothesis, written before it is looked for. All three strings must be non-empty.

threshold.description: OPTIONAL machine-readable half of the refutation condition: the observation counts as a refutation when metric operator value holds. A condition that cannot be written in this form is still valid (the gate does not require it) but is reported as 'not machine-checkable' by the instruments. When present, all three fields are checked strictly -- a broken threshold looks checkable and is not, which is worse than no threshold.

next_observations.description: LEGACY (pre-round-1). A single undifferentiated list that mixed literature questions with self-experiments. Kept only so that records in a pre_split_files entry stay valid; records in a newer file must use next_literature_questions + next_internal_measurements instead.

next_literature_questions.description: Questions a literature search could answer, phrased so the search planner (S7) can turn each into a query. Required (non-empty) for every hypothesis in a file not listed in state/cycle_exemptions.json.

next_internal_measurements.description: Measurements to run against this repository's own ledgers or artifacts. Required (a list, possibly empty) for every hypothesis in a file not listed in state/cycle_exemptions.json: 'nothing to measure internally' is a decision that must be stated, not a field left out.
